reviewNotes: Reviewed all 140 exported speech keys from 20 cards against data/pages68.json vocabulary and source furigana. Every key is a sentence, full explanation or complete procedural answer clause, so every clip uses 1.0. No standalone vocabulary or very short phrases occur. Topic/contrast は -> わ selected by exact key/occurrence; lexical はんだん, はずし, はげしく, はやめ/はやく, はっきり, はいり, きはつせい, はなします, はいき and はいぜん retained. Directional へ -> え selected only for oil, seasoning liquid, egg liquid, water, food/dish transfer and serving destination inputs; lexical へらす and へんしょく retained. Every を checked as object particle -> お. Checked 生焼けなまやけ, 煮崩れにくずれ, 過加熱かかねつ, 卵液らんえき, 霜降りしもふり, 揮発性 きはつせい, 廃棄はいき and 配膳はいぜん against source furigana. Katakana converted retaining gemination and sounds (ぱさぱさ, べちゃべちゃ, ばらんす). Final punctuation added to clauses. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. Text review only; audible articulation and pitch accent not verified.
